bio: In his aptly named contemporary restaurant, chef Romain Bersan shows a distinct talent for cooking up modern cuisine. Spices make a welcome appearance, perfectly dosed with a sure hand (a case in point being the poultry jus elevated with smoked paprika and sake). Vegetarians can rest assured that the chef also caters to their dietary requirements. His delicious starter of vitello tonnato was nothing short of an escapade to Italy....
